blocks.title: Varso Place Underground Parking
blocks.photoAlt: Varso Place entrance and towers at dusk

paragraphs.html: Located on levels -1 and -2 in Varso 1 (Varso 1) and level -1 in Varso 2 (Varso 2).
The parking ticket can be paid by card at the automatic payment machine (automatyczny kasjer) or by card/cash at reception in the main lobby.
To reach the ground floor, take the “F” elevators (winda F) to floor 0 (parter), then turn right toward reception.

items: Head to the main Varso entrance at the Chmielna/Jana Pawła II intersection (róg ul. Chmielnej i al. Jana Pawła II).
Use your QR code to access the elevators on the right of the main entrance, to the left of reception.
The QR code will direct you to Box Reception (recepcja Box) on the 22nd floor.

paragraphs.html: Street parking is available around the building. Payment can be made at a parking meter (parkomat) or via SkyCash / your bank’s mobile parking app (mobiParking).

items: Fast Urban Railway (Szybka Kolej Miejska / SKM)

blocks.title: Getting to the lobby
blocks.photoAlt: Varso Tower lobby with turnstiles, colorful wall panels, and indoor tree

paragraphs.html: Head to the main Varso entrance at the Chmielna/Jana Pawła II intersection. Please use your QR code to access the elevators on the right of the main entrance (left to the reception). The QR code will automatically direct you to your reception at the 22nd floor.

blocks.title: Check-in
blocks.photoAlt: Box Warsaw lobby with reception desk, seating, chandeliers, and Box wall logo

paragraphs.html: Once you arrive at the 22nd floor, please use the tablets available at the reception desk to register as a Box guest and select the name of your Recruiting Coordinator. You may be asked to sign the NDA again. Your coordinator will meet you in the lobby and help you get started with your interviews.

cards.title: Photo ID
cards.body: Please bring a valid government ID (license, passport, or other government-issued ID) to verify your identity at check-in.

cards.title: NDA
cards.body: Before your scheduled interview, please ensure that you electronically sign our NDA using Box Sign through the link provided by your Recruiting Coordinator.

cards.title: Arrival and departure
cards.body: Please keep the printed QR code you received from the Varso Tower ground floor reception with you, as you may need it to exit through the gates on the ground floor.

contact.heading: Questions?
contact.body: Got a question we didn't cover? Reach out to your Recruiter and Recruiting Coordinator.
